# Jubilees Chapter 14 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 14:2 — "I am going away childless" vs. "I go hence childless"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "seeing I go hence childless" | Archaic literal |
| LOGOS | "since I am going away childless" | Modern formal |
| PNEUMA | "I have no child" | Abbreviated paraphrase |

**SOPHIA:** Adopted LOGOS. "Going away childless" captures the Ge'ez idiom of dying without heir. PNEUMA's "I have no child" is accurate but loses the mortality dimension of the phrase.

---

## 14:6 — "counted/reckoned to him as righteousness"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "counted to him for righteousness" | "Counted for" |
| LOGOS | "reckoned to him as righteousness" | "Reckoned as" — standard NT echoing formula |
| PNEUMA | "God counted that trust as righteousness" | Adds "trust" as subject; "God" as explicit actor |

**SOPHIA:** Adopted LOGOS. "Reckoned to him as righteousness" is the established translation formula (cf. Gen 15:6; Rom 4:3), preserving both the Jubilees passage and its canonical resonance. PNEUMA's "trust" glosses "faith/belief."

---

## 14:13 — "horror of great darkness" vs. "great dark dread"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "a horror of great darkness fell upon him" | Traditional rendering |
| LOGOS | "a great dark dread came over him" | Formal equivalent |
| PNEUMA | "a terrifying, smothering darkness" | Vivid expansion |

**SOPHIA:** Adopted LOGOS "a great dark dread." "Horror of great darkness" (EMET) follows KJV Gen 15:12 — appropriate for biblical echo. LOGOS's "great dark dread" is equally valid and slightly more accessible. PNEUMA's expansion adds "smothering" which is not in the source.

---

## 14:19 — "Phiblites" — Jubilees-unique people name

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the Phiblites" | Preserved as transliterated |
| LOGOS | "the Phiblites" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "the Phiblites" | Same — all three agree |

**SOPHIA:** No divergence. "Phiblites" is a Jubilees-specific variant not in MT Gen 15:19-21; all three translators correctly preserve the Ge'ez form.

---

## 14:21 — "we made a covenant with Abram" — angelic first person

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "we made a covenant with Abram, even as we had covenanted with Noah in this month" | Full literal with "even as" |
| LOGOS | "we made a covenant with Abram, just as we had covenanted with Noah in this same month" | "Just as" for "even as" |
| PNEUMA | "we angels made our covenant with Abram, just as we had covenanted with Noah in this same month" | Adds "angels" for clarity |

**SOPHIA:** Adopted LOGOS. "Just as we had covenanted with Noah" is the formal parallel. PNEUMA's "we angels" is a helpful gloss but introduces editorial clarification not in the source.

---

**Total disagreements: 5**
